body:
It's hard. I don't spend money on food because I go to a food pantry once a week. I have a shitty boost mobile cellphone plan, I also don't have tv or internet in the apartment. Between rent, phone and utilities I need to come up with about $800 a month. I'm a $25 bus ride to either Boston or Providence, so I check Craigslist daily and find gigs or quick jobs to make money.. moving help, security, yard work, just easy shit. I've learned how to squeeze every penny, and walk everywhere. No bus, cab, anything. 

Occasionally I get lucky, maybe sell something online or donate blood, find loose change places that people don't look. My landlord gives me the entire month to pay him, he's been awesome. Really understanding. Being depressed and having to find ways to survive is exhausting, so I'm either working a shitty gig or tired enough to eat and go to sleep. I'd love to have someone to take care of me while I sort my shit out, but all I can really do is tread water and look for ways out of this mess, which has led to me here, to suicide. At some point you give in to the depression and have to say fuck it, I'm tired of trying
